rewards.intro: Earn points on every purchase and use them for discounts on future orders.
rewards.earnText: Get 5 points for every €25 spent. Points are credited once the order payment is confirmed.

rewards.c1: You must be a registered customer to take part.
rewards.c2: Points are credited once payment is received and the order is dispatched.
rewards.c3: Points expire 90 days after the date they are added.
rewards.c4: Points cannot be exchanged for money and are non-refundable and non-transferable.
